sessions.title: Reflection on First Italian Introduction Practice
sessions.focus: Practice introductions, names, where you are from, and one or two easy follow-up questions.
sessions.summary: The session focused on practicing simple introductions and basic conversational phrases about well-being and location. The learner showed effort in attempting Italian responses but often switched to other languages or incomplete phrases. There were some successful uses of greetings and simple questions, but the learner struggled with forming coherent sentences and needed frequent prompts. Positive reinforcement was given to encourage attempts and ensure a low-pressure environment.
strengths: Learner greeted and used basic phrases like 'bene' and 'e come stai?'.
Shows willingness to try speaking Italian aloud despite difficulty.
Responds when prompted and repeats some phrases.
Maintains a calm and positive attitude during the session.

sessions.title: First Italian Speaking Practice: Introductions and Basic Questions
sessions.focus: Practice introductions, names, where you are from, and one or two easy follow-up questions.
sessions.summary: In this session, we focused on practicing simple Italian introductions, including stating one's name and origin, along with easy follow-up questions. The learner showed initial hesitancy but managed to respond with short Italian phrases with some help and encouragement. The tutor maintained a calm pace and provided immediate positive feedback. Although the learner mixed in Spanish briefly, the session ended with attempts to use Italian question words.
strengths: Learner was willing to try speaking Italian despite initial hesitation.
Responded correctly to simple prompts like 'Bene.'
Showed readiness to practice follow-up questions with tutor prompting.
needsWork: Learner's confidence to speak without resorting to other languages or silence.
Pronunciation clarity to improve understanding, though not a major focus yet.
Building familiarity with Italian question words to smoothly ask and answer.
nextDrills: Practice saying 'My name is...' and asking 'What is your name?' aloud with short role-play.
Use short question and answer drills: 'Where are you from?' / 'I am from...'.
Repeat simple greetings and responses aloud to build confidence.
cultureMoments: Discuss simple greetings typical in Italian culture, like the use of 'Bene' or 'Ciao.'
